name: dot
description: An always-on companion for Claude Code, after OpenAI's dots: a named avatar that keeps standing responsibilities, runs them on schedules in the background, does read-only proactive research, keeps notes you can read, and gates risky actions with Custom Rules and an independent Auto-review.

proactiveMinutes.title: Proactive research interval (minutes)
proactiveMinutes.description: How long between read-only research passes per project while you are idle. 0 turns proactive research off.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before research
idleMinutes.description: Proactive research only starts after you have been away from the prompt this long.

reviewModel.title: Auto-review model
reviewModel.description: The model that reviews consequential actions before they run.
